Our features

Fast

Pages load quickly because there is nothing to build or install.

Themeable

Change a few variables and every card picks up the new colours.

Responsive

One column on phones, three columns once the screen is wide enough.

Dark mode

The page follows your system setting and switches by itself.

Accessible

Text keeps strong contrast in both themes, and motion can be turned off.

Reusable

Add another card by copying one block and changing the icon.

Performance Optimization Homework

Student: Muhammadmuso Fatkhullaev (202637351)

Optimizations Applied (3 items):

  • 1. Lazy Loading Images: Added loading="lazy" to all below-the-fold images to prevent unnecessary initial network traffic.
  • 2. Deferring Scripts: Added the defer attribute to JavaScript files so scripts download asynchronously without blocking HTML parsing.
  • 3. Resource Preloading: Added for critical stylesheets to speed up the critical rendering path.

Lighthouse Score Comparison

Before Optimization

78

After Optimization

100

Description: By implementing lazy loading for images, deferring non-critical scripts, and preloading stylesheets, the page load performance score improved significantly from 78 to 100 on Lighthouse.
